searchText: I added a few links to some of my projects that use self-destruct here: https://twitter.com/ricmoo/status/1644366362419032065?s=46&t=4AO0rTqq96dYfzxweu6_8Q hope I explained the SD situation correctly. So <@358385024573243393> how do you feel about EIP 6780 and still allowing Create2+SD but just in the same transaction? I feel that doesn’t really help contract upgradability. It works for emulating rich transactions via wisps. But I’d rather have rich transactions. 🙂 Is the main issue with SD the refund counter? I’m fine nixing that. 🙂 I don't believe so. The main issue is having mutable code IIRC. That is, the code at some address can change after it has been set. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6780 nicely sums it up as "The SELFDESTRUCT opcode requires large changes to the state of an account, in particular removing all code and storage. This will not be possible in the future with Verkle trees: Each account will be stored in many different account keys, which will not be obviously connected to the root account." Been a while since I was involved in this though, so I may be mis-remembering.
